name: Son Juaneda
description: An eighteenth-century Menorcan farmhouse on the road to Cala Morell, in the same family since 1967, when Jerónimo Capella bought it. Today it is nine rooms and an estate that still works; much of its electricity comes from a 29 kWp solar array of its own.

practicalInfo.acceso: Camí de Cala Morell, 07760 Ciutadella de Menorca.
practicalInfo.horario: The season is not published; confirm 2026 dates on the official site.
